title: Late Fee Review Clock Start Date — Apartment Home Lease Resident Terms
content:
The late fee review clock of an Apartment Home Lease moves: when the latest ACH autopay payment return on the lease is dated within the period (on or after its due date and before the next due date) the review clock starts on the date of that return; when no such draft was returned and the due date fell on a Saturday or a Sunday the review clock starts on the following Monday; otherwise it starts on the due date.

## Terms

**(1) The return looked at.** The most recent return of an ACH autopay draft recorded on the lease — a single return, the latest of all the lease's returned autopay drafts. It moves the clock only when it is dated on or after the period's due date and before the next due date. Returns of payments made by any other instrument do not move the clock.

**(2) Weekend due date.** When that return does not fall within the period and the due date is a Saturday or a Sunday by the calendar, the review clock starts on the Monday that follows.

**(3) Any other case.** The review clock starts on the due date.

## Cases (hypothetical, calendar weekdays as they fell)

| Period due date | Latest returned autopay draft | Review clock starts on |
|---|---|---|
| Saturday 1 March 2025 | none on record | Monday 3 March 2025 |
| Sunday 1 February 2026 | dated 10 December 2025 (outside the period) | Monday 2 February 2026 |
| Thursday 1 May 2025 | dated 6 May 2025 | 6 May 2025 |
| Saturday 1 November 2025 | dated 3 November 2025 | 3 November 2025 |
| Thursday 1 May 2025 | none on record | 1 May 2025 |
